card.name: Linking words before renal failure
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation just before 'acute renal failure' or 'progressive azotemia' in ACE inhibitor and NSAID kidney warnings, such as 'or', 'including', or an opening parenthesis. Also fires once on 'prefect' in a passage about Pontius Pilate.

modes.label: Kidney warning links
modes.description: A linking word or bracket right before acute renal failure or azotemia in drug interaction text.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal function,<< including>> possible acute renal failure.

modes.label: Roman history passage
modes.description: Words in a description of Jesus's trial under Pontius Pilate.
modes.example: condemned to death under the Roman<< prefect>> Pontius Pilate, put to death
